_meta._note: Licence and attribution data, not copy (D-117). Every string under entries[] is shown verbatim, never translated, never passed through copy lint. Thai headings come from copy.th.json: the client maps entries[].group -> groups[].headingKey and renders credits.licenseLine with {licenseName} = entries[].licenseName. A group with no entries is not shown (credits.dataSourcesHeading context). Order of groups[] and entries[] is the display order. No real person or team names (flow F06 G7).
